article.headline: Tate's 22 lead Appalachian State over Texas State 72-61
article.description: — Myles Tate's 22 points helped Appalachian State defeat Texas State 72-61 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Tate's 22 lead Appalachian State over Texas State 72-61
article.story: BOONE, N.C. -- — Myles Tate's 22 points helped Appalachian State defeat Texas State 72-61 on Saturday. Tate added seven rebounds and six assists for the Mountaineers (7-7, 1-2 Sun Belt Conference). Alonzo Dodd scored 14 points and added six rebounds. CJ Huntley had 12 points and 10 rebounds. Tyler Morgan led the way for the Bobcats (8-7, 1-2) with 16 points and two steals. Dylan Dawson added 14 points for Texas State. Drue Drinnon recorded 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
